_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate favors HOLD: 30d momentum pinned near 50, funding subdued, and canceling flow extremes mean no breaker has printed for ±1 rung travel.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both cautionary on supply/risk, but analyst explicitly HOLDs Hope; narrative implies distribution pressure without a forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound with 30d momentum near 50, exchange netflow cools off extremes, funding stays subdued
next_move.invalidated_if: netflow stays pinned extreme and price loses the range (down toward Disbelief), or 30d momentum lifts 70+ with funding expanding (up toward Optimism)
